page_title: NOR 3-2 SEN | Norway v Senegal 23/06/2026, Stats - Flashscore.com | Match

commentary.text: 90+11' That's it for today, Wilton Sampaio has blown his whistle and the game is over.

90+9' Ismail Jakobs sends a lovely ball from the corner into the path of Ismaila Sarr (Senegal), whose close-range header flashes just over the bar. The ball is off of the pitch and it's a goal kick for Norway.
90+9' Ismail Jakobs (Senegal) will deliver the ball into the penalty box from a corner kick.
90+9' Ibrahim Mbaye (Senegal) tries his luck and takes a shot from inside the box. His effort on goal is blocked by a defender.
90+7' Ismail Jakobs (Senegal) takes the corner.
90+6' Sadio Mane (Senegal) produces a dangerous low pass into the penalty area, but the defence manage to cut it out. The ball is out of play. Senegal win a corner kick.

90+3' 3 - 2 GOAL! Superb work from Nicolas Jackson, who plays a vital role in the build-up. He squares it to Ismaila Sarr (Senegal), who beats Orjan Nyland with a brilliant shot into the right side of the net. 3:2.

90+2' Pape Matar Sarr (Senegal) gets into a good scoring position. He creates some space for himself and tries his luck from distance. His decent effort towards the left post is, however, superbly saved by Orjan Nyland!
90' The fourth official shows 9 min. of added time.
90' Martin Odegaard (Norway) will deliver the corner kick.

90' Oscar Bobb (Norway) is the first to arrive to a rebound inside the penalty area and unleashes a quick strike towards the roof of the net that beats the keeper. One of the defenders, however, makes a goal-line clearance. The referee blows his whistle, Norway are awarded a corner kick.
88' Wow, what an escape. Erling Haaland (Norway) has an effort from inside the box but it's brilliantly blocked.
87' A cross from a mid-range free kick, taken by Senegal, is intercepted by one of the defenders.
86' Wilton Sampaio blows his whistle for a foul after Patrick Berg (Norway) hacks down one of his opponents. Senegal have a free kick.
84' Stale Solbakken has decided to substitute Alexander Sorloth and he is replaced by Oscar Bobb (Norway).
84' Torbjorn Lysaker Heggem (Norway) is not able to continue due to his injury and will be replaced by Leo Ostigard.
83' Nicolas Jackson (Senegal) is flagged for offside.

81' Pape Matar Sarr (Senegal) tries to score from mid-range after collecting a rebound, but his shot lacks accuracy and sails high over the bar. The ball goes out of play and Norway will have a goal kick.
80' A poorly executed mid-range free kick by Martin Odegaard (Norway) as he fails to deliver a decent cross. The ball goes out of play and Senegal will have a goal kick.
79' Pape Matar Sarr (Senegal) makes a reckless foul in order to win the ball from his opponent. Wilton Sampaio has a clear sight of it and blows his whistle. Norway get a free kick.
75' Idrissa Gueye (Senegal) goes down under a challenge in the box, but the ref immediately waves away the appeals from all players.
74' Ismaila Sarr (Senegal) announces himself with a close-range shot after a cross, but one of the defenders gets in the way of the ball to thwart him.
74' The attendance for today's match is 80663.
72' Pape Bouna Thiaw prepares a substitution. Kalidou Koulibaly is replaced by Pape Matar Sarr (Senegal).
71' The referee stops play so that a substitution can be made and Andreas Schjelderup (Norway) comes onto the pitch for Antonio Nusa.
70' The number of shots on goal at present is 6:3.
68' A cooling break is underway.
66' Senegal can’t profit from the corner as the defence clear the ball upfield.
65' Ibrahim Mbaye (Senegal) tries to send a pass but it's blocked. Senegal have been awarded a corner kick.
63' Here is a change. Lamine Camara is going off and Pape Bouna Thiaw gives the last tactical orders to Pathe Ciss (Senegal).
63' Edouard Mendy (Senegal) is substituted due to injury. Pape Bouna Thiaw gives a chance to Mory Diaw.
60' Edouard Mendy (Senegal) is clearly asking for some medical attention with his painful gestures. The extent of his injury is yet to be discovered.

58' 3 - 1 Patrick Berg is in a good shooting position, but he sees his teammate and passes the ball to him. Erling Haaland (Norway) takes it nicely and beats the goalkeeper with a precise shot which bounces in off the bar to make the score 3:1.
54' Pape Bouna Thiaw decides to make a substitution. Pape Gueye will be replaced by Ibrahim Mbaye (Senegal).
54' The substitution has been made. Ismail Jakobs (Senegal) has replaced El Hadji Malick Diouf.

53' 2 - 1 A superb goal from great team play! Ismaila Sarr (Senegal) latches on to a perfect pass and fires an excellent shot into the top right corner. There is nothing a goalkeeper can do about shots like that.
52' Orjan Nyland makes a superb save to deny a header which was nodded low towards the middle of the goal by Nicolas Jackson (Senegal) after a cross from the side.
48' 2 - 0 Erling Haaland (Norway) receives a precise pass inside the box from Martin Odegaard and he beats the goalkeeper with a neat finish into the right side of the net. 2:0.
46' Substitution. Fredrik Aursnes (Norway) makes way for Patrick Berg.
46' The second half gets underway.
45+5' The match has reached half-time.

45+4' Erling Haaland (Norway) attempts to convert a lofted cross as he jumps high and heads the ball to the bottom right corner. Edouard Mendy shows his brilliant reflexes and pulls off a glorious save to stop the ball from hitting the net.
45+4' Erling Haaland (Norway) fires a shot from close range, but he is somehow only able to hit the right post!

45+1' Ismaila Sarr (Senegal) was presented with a great chance after a cross found him all alone in the box, but his effort towards the middle of the goal lacked pace and was comfortably saved by Orjan Nyland.
45' We will have 4 min. of added time.

43' 1 - 0 GOAL! A terrible mistake leads to a goal. The defender ends up losing possession, allowing Marcus Pedersen (Norway) to pick up the ball before slotting it into the back of the net to make it 1:0.

41' What a great effort! Lamine Camara (Senegal) decides to unleash a long-range shot. Despite hitting it very well, it scorches inches wide of the left post. We could have witnessed a magnificent goal. The ball is off of the pitch and it's a goal kick for Norway.
40' Sander Berge (Norway) tries to find Erling Haaland, but he puts too much power on the pass.
38' Martin Odegaard (Norway) runs onto a loose pass inside the box and releases a tremendous shot towards the middle of the goal. However, Edouard Mendy anticipates the shot and makes a decent save.
36' Some great controlled play and passing from Norway. They are increasing their possession of the ball and trying to open up the opposition's defence to hit them swiftly on the break.
31' Lamine Camara (Senegal) tries to find Nicolas Jackson, but he puts too much power on the through ball.

28' Ambitious effort from Nicolas Jackson (Senegal). He finds himself in a great position after collecting a precise pass inside the penalty area and goes for goal, but it never troubles the goalkeeper and flies well over the bar. The ball is off of the pitch and it's a goal kick for Norway.
23' The referee blows for a cooling break.
19' A pass from David Wolfe (Norway) is intercepted by Edouard Mendy and the move breaks down.
16' El Hadji Malick Diouf (Senegal) overhits the corner kick and none of his teammates can their head on it.

14' CHANCE! Martin Odegaard (Norway) fires just over the crossbar from inside the box after running onto a splendid pass from Marcus Pedersen. The ball goes out of play and Senegal will have a goal kick.
13' Stale Solbakken is forced to make a change. Julian Ryerson is unable to continue due to injury, Marcus Pedersen (Norway) comes on.
11' Ismaila Sarr (Senegal) is caught offside!
9' Lamine Camara (Senegal) delivers a poor cross from a free kick as one of the defenders comfortably clears it away.
8' Idrissa Gueye (Senegal) looks to pass after collecting a rebound, but a lack of options forces him to shoot from distance and it's easily blocked by an opponent.
6' A pass from Ismaila Sarr (Senegal) is intercepted by Orjan Nyland and the move breaks down.
4' Nicolas Jackson (Senegal) finds himself beyond the last defender, but the game is stopped by the referee after the linesman signals for offside.
4' The ball is whipped in from the corner by Julian Ryerson (Norway), but one of the defenders gets it clear.
3' Kristoffer Ajer (Norway) rises highest from the corner to head at goal, but his low effort towards the middle of the goal is comfortably saved by the goalkeeper.
3' Julian Ryerson (Norway) is about to take a corner kick.
2' Martin Odegaard (Norway) will take the corner.

2' Antonio Nusa (Norway) reacts well to get to the rebound and takes a shot from the edge of the box, but he fails to get the ball through the players standing between him and the goal. The linesman points to the corner flag, Norway are going to take it.
1' Martin Odegaard (Norway) is heading toward the corner flag to take the set piece.
1' The first half of this match is about to start.
The players are on the pitch and Norway will have the kick-off.
Wilton Sampaio will officiate today.
